div.p: When something big comes out of the jungle, something that won't die to a lasgun, that's when they call for you. You carry the heavy weapons. The flamers that burn the jungle back. The heavy bolters that can punch through chitin and scale. The weapons that turn monsters into paste.

You're not fast. You're not quiet. But when the Catachan Devils come, when the giant scorpions attack, when something that shouldn't exist tries to eat your squad, you're the one who makes it regret that decision. You're the wall of fire and lead that stands between your squad and the things that want to kill them.
Lock and load. Make every shot count. The jungle is full of targets.
Catachan: Rock, Marbo, Arden, Jackson, Straken, Greiss, Ripper, Sly, Nork, Catachan
Choose one for each:
Hard Eyes, Dead Eyes, or Watchful Eyes
Helmet, Shorn Hair, or Bandana
Heavy Weapons Harness or Standard Gear
Built Body, Bulky Body, or Scarred Body
You are Catachan, so you get this move.
When you survey the battlefield, even for a moment, and ask, "What here is the biggest threat?" the GM will tell you, honestly.
You start with these moves:
When you lay down covering fire to protect an ally, roll+CHA. ✴On a 10+ you grant them +1 armor or remove one threat. ✴On a 7–9, they are protected, but you draw the threat to yourself.
You ignore the clumsy tag on armor you wear.

This is your weapon. There are many like it, but this one is yours. Your weapon is your best friend. It is your life. You master it as you master your life. Your weapon, without you, is useless. Without your weapon, you are useless. You must wield your weapon true.
Choose a base description, all are 3 weight:
Choose the range that best fits your weapon:
Choose two enhancements:

ul.li: Area effect. Deal damage to multiple targets.
Rapid fire. Can fire multiple shots per turn.

div.p: Choose a look:
When you give an order based on your heavy weapons support, roll+Cha. ✴On a 7+, they choose one:
✴On a 10+, you also take +1 forward against them. ✴On a miss, they do as they please and you take -1 forward against them.
Eliminate a high-value target with heavy weapons.
Endanger yourself to protect someone weaker than you with covering fire.
Destroy a threat that normal weapons can't harm.
Your load is 12+Str. You start with rations (5 uses, 1 weight), carapace armor (2 armor, 3 weight), and your heavy weapon. Choose your secondary weapon:

ul.li: Laspistol (near, 1 weight) and Catachan knife (close, 1 weight)

div.p: Choose one:
Fill in the name of one of your companions in at least one:
_______________'s reckless behavior endangers the whole squad!
_______________ has stood by me in battle and can be trusted completely.
I respect the skills of _______________ but hope they will someday see the value of heavy weapons.
_______________ is a brave soul, I have much to learn from them.
When you gain a level from 2-5, choose from these moves.
When you deal damage, deal +1d4 damage.
When you lay down suppressing fire in an area, enemies must defy danger to enter that area. ✴On a 10+, they can't enter at all. ✴On a 7-9, they can enter but take damage.

When you make your armor take the brunt of damage dealt to you, the damage is negated but you must reduce the armor value of your armor (your choice) by 1. The value is reduced each time you make this choice. If the reduction leaves the item with 0 armor it is destroyed.
Choose one extra enhancement for your heavy weapon.
When you read the signs during combat, you take +1.
When you keep firing at the same target, your next attack against that target deals +1d4 damage.
Get one move from another specialization. Treat your level as one lower for choosing the move.
You gain +1 armor.
When you have access to a tech-priest or armory you can upgrade your heavy weapon. Choose one enhancement to add permanently.
When you gain a level from 6-10, choose from these moves or the level 2-5 moves.
Replaces: Merciless
When you deal damage, deal +1d8 damage.
Replaces: Area Denial
When you lay down suppressing fire in an area, enemies must defy danger to enter that area. ✴On a 10+, they can't enter at all and take damage if they try. ✴On a 7-9, they can enter but take damage.
Replaces: Armor Mastery

When you choose to let your armor take the brunt of damage dealt to you, the damage is negated and you take +1 forward against the attacker, but you must reduce the armor value of your armor (your choice) by 1. The value is reduced each time you make this choice. If the reduction leaves the item with 0 armor it is destroyed.
Replaces: Target Priority
When you read the signs during combat, you take +2 and can ask an additional question.
Replaces: Sustained Fire
When you keep firing at the same target, your next attack against that target deals +1d8 damage.
Requires: Multiclass Dabbler
Get one move from another specialization. Treat your level as one lower for choosing the move.
Replaces: Iron Hide
You gain +2 armor.
Replaces: Weapon Master
When you have access to a tech-priest or armory you can upgrade your heavy weapon. Choose two enhancements to add permanently.

When you go into battle, roll+WIS. ✴On a 10+, name someone who will live and someone who will die. ✴On a 7-9, name someone who will live or someone who will die. Name NPCs, not player characters. The GM will make your vision come true, if it's even remotely possible. ✴On a 6- you see your own death and consequently take -1 ongoing throughout the battle.
When you look over an enemy's defenses, ask the GM how much armor they have.
When you take aim on a 12+ you deal your damage, avoid their attack, and suppress, dismay, or frighten your enemy.

When you choose to go out in a blaze of glory at death's door, you unleash everything your heavy weapon has left in a final, apocalyptic barrage. You may target every enemy in sight with devastating firepower. Roll+Cha. ✴On a 10+, you deal your damage+3d12 to all enemies in sight, ignoring all armor. The area becomes a permanent kill zone—enemies must defy danger at -2 to enter it, and those who fail take your damage+1d10. All allies take +2 forward and +2 armor for the rest of the battle. Your final barrage creates a legend—the battlefield is permanently scarred, and future enemies who hear of it take -1 ongoing. ✴On a 7-9, you deal your damage+2d10 to all enemies, ignoring armor. The area becomes a kill zone for the rest of the battle. All allies take +1 forward and +1 armor. ✴On a miss, your weapon overheats and explodes in a cataclysmic blast, dealing your damage+2d10 to all nearby enemies and creating a permanent barrier of fire and wreckage that blocks all movement. Your final stand becomes a legend, and your squad takes +2 forward and +1 armor for the rest of the battle. Your sacrifice ensures the mission succeeds.
